_readme: Add real partner entries under each category's `partners` array once you have an approved affiliate/referral agreement. Entries need: id (url-safe), name, url (your tracking link), blurb {en,zh}, disclosure {en,zh}. Categories with no partners show a quote-request form instead. Never invent commissions or partner names.

pitch.en: Shipping from China or another origin? Tell us the lane and cargo and get quotes from vetted forwarders.
pitch.zh: 从中国或其他起运地发货？提交线路和货物信息，获取货代报价。

pitch.en: Need storage and fulfilment close to your customers? Request a quote from overseas warehouse providers.
pitch.zh: 需要靠近买家的仓储与配送？向海外仓服务商询价。

cta.zh: 获取 VAT 申报报价

pitch.en: Selling into the EU or UK? Get help with VAT registration, IOSS and periodic filing.
pitch.zh: 向欧盟或英国销售？获取 VAT 注册、IOSS 与定期申报服务报价。

pitch.en: Unsure about classification, duty or documents? Ask a licensed customs broker to review your shipment.
pitch.zh: 对归类、关税或单证没把握？让持牌报关行帮你复核。

name.zh: 跨境收款 / 支付工具

pitch.en: Getting paid from marketplaces or customers abroad? Compare receiving accounts and FX fees.
pitch.zh: 从海外平台或客户收款？对比收款账户与汇兑费用。
